name: SaveInCloud Cloudlets
line: Run apps in managed container environments across Brazil.

free.text: R$200 credit for 30 days; 14-day trial also advertised

cells.regions: Standard: SP/Vinhedo, Fortaleza, Brasília; Premium: Vinhedo

work.math: Standard subtotal R$78.093 = 2 × R$0.023 × 730 hours + R$0.028 × 730 hours for IP + 100 × R$0.24 for data sent out + 0.1 × R$0.73 for disk. Builds, inbound traffic, system and log disk, and tax are extra.
Standard subtotal R$155.473 = 8 × R$0.019 × 730 + R$20.44 for IP + R$24 for data sent out + R$0.073 for files. 1 vCPU is not verified, and builder, inbound and system disk costs are extra.

Subtotal R$273.733 = 16 × R$0.019 × 730 hours + R$20.44 IP + R$24 data sent out + 10.1 × R$0.73 disk. 10 GB private database traffic is free. Seven dumps add 7 × R$0.73 (dump size unknown). Backup node and tax are extra.
